summary: Aggregated supplier monthly invoice excluded from scheduled payrun due to 'on_hold' supplier status flag
description: Issue summary: A consolidated monthly invoice from vendor 'EdgeFabric Ltd' (supplier_id: S-8432) for February was not included in the scheduled payrun executed on 2026-03-09. Vendor reported non-receipt of payment on 2026-03-10. Impact: Single vendor payment (~$42,300 USD) delayed to next pay cycle; vendor escalated to finance manager and threatened potential service interruption. Environment: Production AP system; scheduled payrun job 'payrun-scheduler-v3' (runs daily at 02:00 UTC) and upstream supplier-sync service (finance-sync). Steps to reproduce: 1) Query suppliers table for S-8432 on snapshot before payrun: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_status, tax_form_received FROM suppliers WHERE supplier_id='S-8432'; 2) Observe supplier_status = 'on_hold' and tax_form_received = false. 3) Inspect payrun filter: SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE supplier_status='active' AND due_date <= '2026-03-09'; invoices for S-8432 excluded. Logs (relevant excerpts): - payrun-scheduler-v3.log @ 2026-03-09T02:01:12Z: "Filtering 12,430 invoices by supplier_status=active" - finance-sync.log @ 2026-03-08T23:47:30Z: "[INFO] supplier_sync: set supplier_id=S-8432 status=on_hold reason=missing_tax_document source=auto-reconcile" Initial ask: Finance requested immediate clearance for the payrun and a postmortem of why automated sync flagged the vendor.
investigation_notes: Timeline & findings: - 2026-03-08 23:47 UTC: finance-sync job #20260308-11 ran a full supplier reconciliation after ingesting third-party tax form feed. The job's new mapping logic (introduced by PR #412) treats missing tax_form_received as grounds for 'on_hold'. Previously the system tagged 'needs_attention' but allowed payrun inclusion. - The scheduled payrun uses a strict filter (supplier_status='active') that excludes both 'on_hold' and 'needs_attention'. - Root cause: Mapping change in finance-sync PR 412 unintentionally hardened the status transition to 'on_hold' for suppliers missing ancillary tax docs. The payrun filter relied on previous semantics, resulting in exclusion. - Secondary cause: No guardrail or alert existed when a supplier with outstanding invoices moved into 'on_hold' within 12 hours of a scheduled payrun. - Evidence: git commit diff (finance-sync/config/status-mapping): removed 'needs_attention' fallback, replaced with 'on_hold'. See related PR: github.com/redwood-inference/finance-sync/pull/412. Hypothesis validation: Replayed supplier-sync on staging with identical inputs produced supplier_status='on_hold' and confirmed payrun exclusion. Stakeholders contacted: finance-ops, payments-engineering, vendor-relations.

resolution: Workaround applied: manual override set for S-8432 and payrun reprocessed; payment completed on 2026-03-11. Permanent fix: reverted status mapping change in finance-sync (rolled back PR 412) to restore prior 'needs_attention' semantics and avoid automatic 'on_hold' placement. Engineering deployed a mapping fix in finance-sync v1.8.3 on 2026-03-12 and added a new unit/integration test to cover payrun-exclusion scenarios. Added monitoring/alerting: watch for supplier_status changes to 'on_hold' for any supplier with invoice state 'pending_payrun' and trigger a paging alert for finance on-call. Follow-ups: - Finance to request missing tax documentation from EdgeFabric; - Payments team to run backfill audit for last 7 days to ensure no other invoices were excluded; - Create runbook entry for manual override and expedited payrun reprocess (confluence page linked). Ticket closed after verification of payment and deployment of the mapping rollback and alerting.
follow_up_tasks: Finance: confirm tax doc from EdgeFabric and update supplier record (S-8432)
Payments Eng: run backfill audit for payruns between 2026-03-06 and 2026-03-10 and open INT tickets for any further excluded vendors
Engineering: add integration test and merge new mapping (finance-sync v1.8.3) and monitor for 72h
notes: This ticket captures an intersection between AP business logic and automated supplier status sync. Recommendation: coordinate schema/semantics changes across Finance and Payments before deploying mapping updates; include a payrun-compatibility checklist for finance-sync PRs.
